description: The authoritative free information layer on the EU battery passport, mandatory on 18 February 2027. Verified against EUR-Lex.
image_alt: Battery Digital Passport — EU compliance guidelines and mandatory dates.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Researching and verifying EU regulatory requirements for battery and EV manufacturers.

editorial.testing: All regulatory requirements and dates are cross-referenced directly with EUR-Lex and official EU Commission publications. Anything not yet verified is strictly labeled as unverified.
editorial.monetization: This site is funded by vendor sponsorships and the sale of a paid readiness toolkit. We do not sell compliance software.
editorial.corrections: Corrections to regulatory data are made immediately upon verification against official EU sources. All pages carry a last-verified date.
